item.title: Pretty Lights Announces First Album Since 2013, 45-Song ‘A Trip Thru Time Fantastic’
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're excited to share some news from the electronic music scene. Pretty Lights, aka Derrick Vincent Smith, has just announced his first new album in 13 years, and it's a massive project. Get ready for 'A Trip Thru Time Fantastic' - a 45-song album, divided into nine sections, or 'constellations' as Pretty Lights calls them.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: "This is Pretty Lights' fifth studio album, and it's been a long time coming. The last one, 'A Color Map of the Sun', was released back in 2013. But don't worry, the wait is worth it. The first three constellations, featuring 15 songs, are available to stream and download for free on the Pretty Lights website. You won't find them on your usual DSPs just yet.
[Music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: "So, what inspired Pretty Lights to create such an epic project? According to his social media post, he's been focusing on living creative systems, conscious cohesion, and experimenting with sound. And it's not just about the music - he's also been building a life, finding spiritual paths, and starting a family.
[Music fades out, and the host speaks in a more conversational tone]
Host: "And to make things even more exciting, Pretty Lights is embarking on a seven-city summer and fall tour, which includes stops at Ohio's Secret Dreams Music Festival, his own Yahn Dawn festival in Colorado, and Florida's Hulaween in October. It's going to be a wild ride, and we can't wait to see what's in store for Pretty Lights and his fans.
[Music transitions back in, and the host wraps up the episode]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. Make sure to check out Pretty Lights' new album, 'A Trip Thru Time Fantastic', and catch him on tour this summer and fall. We'll be back with more music news and updates soon. Until then, keep on trending!"
